Jwt._comment: Set this to at least 32 random characters. The app refuses to start in production without it, deliberately — a default key would let anyone forge an administrator session.

Uploads._comment: Kept OUTSIDE the site folder. A redeploy replaces the site directory wholesale, and photographs stored inside it would be erased by a routine deployment.

Mail._comment: Resend goes out over HTTPS, which is what works on shared hosting where outbound SMTP ports are usually blocked. Leave SmtpHost empty when using Resend.
